item.title: Bone and Biscuit Best Buddy – Jan 27 – Teddy
item.description: Here is this week's best buddy, Teddy He's only 3 month old, and an Akita/ German shepherd cross Teddy may be a little reserved at first, often barking and keeping his distance when he meets new people. However, give him a few minutes, and he'll lose all sense of personal space, showering you with affection and showing off his goofy personality! If you think Teddy could be a good fit for your home, please contact the NP SPCA. If not, PLEASE share this video so we can find him his forever home Th
